what_it_checks: that our published first-touch-prefill headline reproduces from the raw per-workload rows
the_finding: The 36-workload headline is an EXACT arithmetic identity: cut(n) = 256*floor(n/256)/n, reproducible to five decimals without the GPU data. The real-trace mean is lower (0.668) and 6 of 29 workloads fall BELOW the pre-registered 0.30 floor. Both are reported; neither is hidden.
